name: Synatic
description_en:
Synatic is a data integration platform for building flows from configured source, transformation and destination steps. Current marketing also presents AgencyFuse insurance solutions; those named solutions are not treated as features automatically present in every general Synatic subscription.

The official tutorials describe querying a source, mapping fields and inspecting individual run/record failures. They provide a practical evaluation model, but this research did not run a customer account or establish current connector entitlements.
description_zh:
Synatic 是通过已配置源、转换与目标步骤构建流程的数据集成平台。当前营销也展示 AgencyFuse 保险解决方案，不能把这些命名方案视为每个通用 Synatic 订阅均自带的功能。

官方教程描述查询源、映射字段及检查逐次运行／记录失败，可作实用评估模型。本次未运行客户账号，也未确认当前连接器权限。

core_features.explanation_zh: 检查失败步骤记录，对比当前与原始值。

core_features.explanation_zh: Writer 序列化、记录合并及运行文件交付分属不同步骤。

sections.title_en: Make the query, mapping and destination explicit
sections.en: The Salesforce-to-SQL Server tutorial creates a Solution and Flow, authorizes a Salesforce connection, selects records with SOQL and maps fields into destination columns with data types. Its published example is dated 2021, so menus and authentication details need current validation. A proposed evaluation could copy a small account subset with stable source IDs into a separate SQL table. Verify names, nulls and type conversion in that table; a green run indicator is not a replacement for checking delivered records.
sections.zh: Salesforce 至 SQL Server 教程先创建 Solution 与 Flow，授权 Salesforce 连接，通过 SOQL 选记录，再按数据类型映射到目标列。该示例发布于 2021 年，菜单与认证细节需在当前版本确认。建议评估时把少量账号及稳定源 ID 复制到独立 SQL 表，核对名称、null 及类型转换；绿色运行标识不能代替交付记录检查。

sections.title_en: Serialization and delivery are separate responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 序列化与交付分属不同职责
sections.en: The JSON Writer guide distinguishes selecting the input section, serializing JSON, combining records and delivering a downloadable Run File. A single-object option returns the first object rather than an array. This matters when the downstream consumer expects a complete collection. Test an empty input, one row and several rows, then check nesting and file content. Do not infer that adding a writer automatically transfers the file to an external application or validates its schema.
sections.zh: JSON Writer 指南区分选择输入区段、JSON 序列化、合并记录及生成可下载 Run File。单对象选项返回首个对象而非数组，当下游期待完整集合时尤其重要。应测试空输入、一行和多行，再检查嵌套及文件内容。添加 writer 不代表会自动把文件传到外部应用，也不代表已验证其 schema。

sections.title_en: Find the step and record behind a failed run
sections.title_zh: 找到失败运行背后的步骤与记录
sections.en: Runs lists history; opening a run shows step errors, record numbers and detailed messages. The Record and Original Record tabs distinguish the value entering a step from the parent source value. RunEvents adds execution events and some steps allow input/output recording. For a proposed failure exercise, send an invalid field to a disposable target and confirm its location and the unaffected records. Recorded IO can contain business data, so decide what to retain and expose during support. Automatic retry, rollback and exactly-once delivery were not established.
sections.zh: Runs 列出历史，打开运行可查看步骤错误、记录编号及详细信息。Record 与 Original Record 区分进入步骤的值和父源值，RunEvents 补充执行事件，部分步骤支持记录输入／输出。建议以非法字段写向可丢弃目标，确认错误位置及未受影响记录。IO 记录可能包含业务数据，支持排障时应明确保留及展示范围。本次未确认自动重试、回滚或恰好一次交付。

sections.title_en: The order form controls the subscription bill
sections.en: The published EULA, updated February 2023, puts amounts and licensing tiers/limits in an Order Form. It charges for granted users whether they log in or not, defaults to annual advance invoices unless otherwise specified, states 5% annual increases and allows movement to a higher tier on excess use. This is a commercial boundary to confirm in the actual offer, not a current numeric plan quote. The guessed public pricing URL was inaccessible, and no free/trial duration was verified. Do not import a third-party starting amount.
sections.zh: 2023 年 2 月更新的公开 EULA 将金额与许可档位／上限置于订单，已授予用户无论登录与否均收费，除非另定，默认年度预付；另列每年 5% 调增及超量时可能升档。这些是实际报价需确认的商业边界，不是当前数字套餐报价。本次公开定价 URL 无法访问，未确认免费或试用期限，也未采用第三方起价。

sections.title_en: A hosted-service grant is not source ownership
sections.title_zh: 托管服务使用权不等于源码所有权
sections.en: The EULA grants time-limited internal-business use and says the underlying software is not provided in object or source-code form. Any customer-cloud, embedded resale or broader deployment arrangement needs its own confirmed terms. The homepage’s AgencyFuse offerings and general platform should be scoped separately in an order. This research did not audit infrastructure or approve a contract.
sections.zh: EULA 授予订阅期内的内部业务使用权，并说明不提供底层软件目标码或源码。客户云、嵌入转售或更广部署安排需各自确认条款。首页 AgencyFuse 方案与通用平台也应在订单中分别界定。本次未审计基础设施或批准合同。

sections.en: Evaluate Synatic when someone can define source queries, mappings, destination writes and failure reconciliation, including a relevant insurance workflow if that solution is purchased. It is a weaker fit when broad ETL/API/warehouse labels are the only evidence for a required endpoint or recovery guarantee. Begin with one demonstrable flow before expanding to multiple systems. Current runtime versions, rate limits, throughput, retention and interface languages remain unverified. No application, connector or support service was exercised here.
sections.zh: 如果有人能定义源查询、映射、目标写入及失败对账，可评估 Synatic；购买相关方案时，也可评估保险流程。若所需端点或恢复保证仅由笼统 ETL／API／仓库标签支撑，适用性较弱。应先完成一个可演示流程再扩展多系统。当前运行时、速率限制、吞吐、保留及界面语言仍未核实，本次未实际使用应用、连接器或支持服务。
